dogecoin.text: Dogecoin up 6.4K% in a year that’s insane

Thou Shalt Beware the FOMO Devil

The Sin: Buying at the peak because “everyone’s talking about it” on @X .. Dogecoin at $10 vibes.

The Salvation: Zoom out. Use charts (RSI screaming overbought? Pass). If your gut’s yelling “I’m late,” you probably are. 

Preach discipline; wait
